# clean pca data and prep for data merge - including merging all samples within species
```{r}
# Clean and standardize species names across datasets
pca <- pca %>% mutate(species = tolower(str_trim(species)))
vol <- vol %>% mutate(species = tolower(str_trim(species)))
eco <- eco %>% mutate(species = tolower(str_trim(species)))
loc <- loc %>% mutate(species = tolower(str_trim(species)))

# Merge all datasets
merged_df <- pca %>%
  left_join(vol, by = "species") %>%
  left_join(eco, by = "species") %>%
  left_join(loc, by = "species")

# Check for NA or mismatched species
summary(merged_df)

```

```{r}
# Ensure numeric format for relevant columns
merged_df <- merged_df %>%
  mutate(across(c(avg_volume_estimated, PC1_mean, Precipitation_monthly), as.numeric))

# Remove rows with NA in any of the three main variables
clean_df <- merged_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(avg_volume_estimated), !is.na(PC1_mean), !is.na(Precipitation_monthly))


```

```{r}

# Create a new dataframe with precipitation in cm
clean_df_cm <- clean_df %>%
  mutate(Precip_cm = Precipitation_monthly * 2.54)  # 1 inch = 2.54 cm
# Create a new dataframe without the top 3 precipitation values
clean_df_cm_trimmed <- clean_df_cm %>%
  arrange(desc(Precip_cm)) %>%
  slice(-(1:3))  # Remove top 3 rows by precipitation

# Check the range before and after trimming
range(clean_df$Precipitation_monthly)  # Inches
range(clean_df_cm$Precip_cm)           # cm before trimming
range(clean_df_cm_trimmed$Precip_cm)   # cm after trimming

```


```{r}


# PC1 ~ Precip
cor_pc1 <- cor.test(clean_df_cm_trimmed$Precipitation_monthly, clean_df_cm_trimmed$PC1_mean, method = "pearson")
r_pc1 <- round(cor_pc1$estimate, 2)
p_pc1 <- format.pval(cor_pc1$p.value, digits = 2, eps = 0.001)

# Volume ~ Precip
cor_vol <- cor.test(clean_df_cm_trimmed$Precipitation_monthly, clean_df_cm_trimmed$avg_volume_estimated, method = "pearson")
r_vol <- round(cor_vol$estimate, 2)
p_vol <- format.pval(cor_vol$p.value, digits = 2, eps = 0.001)

```

```{r}

plot_pc1 <- ggplot(clean_df_cm_trimmed, aes(x = Precipitation_monthly, y = PC1_mean, color = Ecology)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  annotate("text", 
           x = Inf, y = Inf, 
           label = paste0("r = ", r_pc1, ", p = ", p_pc1), 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5,
           size = 6, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Spore Shape (PC1) vs. Precipitation",
    x = "30-day Precipitation (mm)",
    y = "Mean PC1 (Spore Shape Axis)",
    color = "Ecology"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
  )


```


```{r}
plot_volume <- ggplot(clean_df_cm_trimmed, aes(x = Precipitation_monthly, y = avg_volume_estimated, color = Ecology)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  annotate("text", 
           x = Inf, y = Inf, 
           label = paste0("r = ", r_vol, ", p = ", p_vol), 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5,
           size = 6, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Spore Volume vs. Precipitation",
    x = "30-day Precipitation (mm)",
    y = "Estimated Spore Volume",
    color = "Ecology"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
  )

```


```{r}
ggsave("Figure_PC1_vs_Precip.png", plot = plot_pc1, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
ggsave("Figure_Volume_vs_Precip.png", plot = plot_volume, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```
